//go:build e2e

// Stage 4a's previous-layout App overlay. scripts/e2e/stage4a-sandbox-runtime.sh copies this file
// over live_app_test.go of the checkout of the commit LEGION_E2E_PREVIOUS_IMAGE was built from
// (main at daemon API contract 37 or 38), beside fixture_test.go.txt, before it builds that
// commit's Stage 4a harness. That commit's harness read the implement App's private key from a
// secret store; the live proofs now hold no key, only the secrets broker's github-app secret, whose
// release of installation tokens the token command prints (lib/github-apps.sh's
// app_token_command, LEGION_E2E_IMPLEMENT_APP_TOKEN_COMMAND, which this branch's harness hands on
// in the fixture's environment). That commit's appauth has no token mode, so this file reads the
// release itself: it declares exactly what that commit's live_test.go and runtime use of it
// (implementTokens with its apps field, Token, Credential, and resolveApp setting r.tokens,
// r.identity and the two default branches), and nothing else.

package sandbox

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/sjawhar/legion/daemon/internal/claim"
	"github.com/sjawhar/legion/daemon/internal/ghbranch"
	"github.com/sjawhar/legion/daemon/internal/ghconfig"
	"github.com/sjawhar/legion/daemon/internal/ghrepo"
	"github.com/sjawhar/legion/daemon/internal/githubrest"
	"github.com/sjawhar/legion/daemon/internal/runtime"
)

// releasedTokens runs the token command for an owner and caches each lease until fewer than
// twenty minutes remain, as the daemon's token manager does.
type releasedTokens struct {
	command string
	mu      sync.Mutex
	leases  map[string]releasedLease
}

type releasedLease struct {
	token     string
	expiresAt time.Time
}

func (b *releasedTokens) lease(ctx context.Context, owner string, readOnly bool) (releasedLease, error) {
	owner = strings.ToLower(owner)
	key := owner
	readOnlyValue := ""
	if readOnly {
		key, readOnlyValue = "read:"+owner, "1"
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if held, ok := b.leases[key]; ok && time.Until(held.expiresAt) > 20*time.Minute {
		return held, nil
	}
	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "sh", "-c", b.command)
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LEGION_GITHUB_OWNER="+owner, "LEGION_GITHUB_READ_ONLY="+readOnlyValue)
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		return releasedLease{}, fmt.Errorf("the implement App's token command for %s: %v: %s", owner, err, strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
	}
	var release struct {
		Installations map[string]struct {
			Token     string `json:"token"`
			ExpiresAt string `json:"expires_at"`
		} `json:"installations"`
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(stdout.Bytes(), &release) != nil {
		return releasedLease{}, errors.New("the implement App's token command printed no release")
	}
	for login, entry := range release.Installations {
		if !strings.EqualFold(login, owner) {
			continue
		}
		expiresAt, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, entry.ExpiresAt)
		if err != nil || entry.Token == "" {
			return releasedLease{}, fmt.Errorf("the implement App's token command released %s's installation without a token and an expiry", login)
		}
		b.leases[key] = releasedLease{token: entry.Token, expiresAt: expiresAt}
		return b.leases[key], nil
	}
	return releasedLease{}, fmt.Errorf("the implement App's token command released no installation on %s", owner)
}

// implementTokens is the harness's ProvisionTokens and GitHubCredential, as that commit's own.
type implementTokens struct {
	apps   *releasedTokens
	owners []string
}

func (t implementTokens) Token(ctx context.Context, owner string) (string, error) {
	lease, err := t.apps.lease(ctx, owner, false)
	return lease.token, err
}

func (t implementTokens) Credential(ctx context.Context, _ claim.Role, owner string) (ghconfig.Bundle, error) {
	owner = strings.ToLower(owner)
	if owner == "" {
		owner = strings.ToLower(t.owners[0])
	}
	bundle := ghconfig.Bundle{Default: owner, Owners: map[string]ghconfig.Rendered{}}
	for _, name := range append([]string{owner}, t.owners...) {
		name = strings.ToLower(name)
		if _, done := bundle.Owners[name]; done {
			continue
		}
		lease, err := t.apps.lease(ctx, name, name != owner)
		if err != nil {
			return ghconfig.Bundle{}, fmt.Errorf("mint the implement App's lease for %s: %w", name, err)
		}
		bundle.Owners[name] = ghconfig.Render(lease.token, "implement", lease.expiresAt)
	}
	return bundle, nil
}

// botIdentity is the token's App bot as git names it: GraphQL's viewer login and the noreply
// email GET /users/<login> gives its id for.
func botIdentity(ctx context.Context, token string) (runtime.GitIdentity, error) {
	do := func(method, path, body string, into any) error {
		request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, "https://api.github.com"+path, strings.NewReader(body))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		request.Header.Set("Authorization", "token "+token)
		request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
		response, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(request)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer response.Body.Close()
		if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s %s answered %d", method, path, response.StatusCode)
		}
		return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(into)
	}
	var viewer struct {
		Data struct {
			Viewer struct {
				Login string `json:"login"`
			} `json:"viewer"`
		} `json:"data"`
	}
	if err := do(http.MethodPost, "/graphql", `{"query":"{viewer{login}}"}`, &viewer); err != nil {
		return runtime.GitIdentity{}, err
	}
	login := viewer.Data.Viewer.Login
	if !strings.HasSuffix(login, "[bot]") {
		return runtime.GitIdentity{}, fmt.Errorf("the implement App's token acts as %q, not an App's bot", login)
	}
	var user struct {
		ID int64 `json:"id"`
	}
	if err := do(http.MethodGet, "/users/"+url.PathEscape(login), "", &user); err != nil || user.ID <= 0 {
		return runtime.GitIdentity{}, fmt.Errorf("the implement App's bot user %s: %v", login, err)
	}
	return runtime.GitIdentity{Name: login, Email: fmt.Sprintf("%d+%s@users.noreply.github.com", user.ID, login)}, nil
}

func (r *liveRig) resolveApp() error {
	command := os.Getenv("LEGION_E2E_IMPLEMENT_APP_TOKEN_COMMAND")
	if command == "" {
		return errors.New("LEGION_E2E_IMPLEMENT_APP_TOKEN_COMMAND is unset: this branch's harness hands it to the previous release's fixture")
	}
	apps := &releasedTokens{command: command, leases: map[string]releasedLease{}}
	branches := make([]string, 2)
	var identity runtime.GitIdentity
	for i, repo := range []ghrepo.Repository{r.env.repo, r.env.repoSecondOwner} {
		lease, err := apps.lease(r.ctx, repo.Owner(), false)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if branches[i], err = ghbranch.DefaultBranch(r.ctx, githubrest.Client{Token: lease.token, API: githubrest.RepositoryAPI("", repo)}, repo); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if i == 0 {
			if identity, err = botIdentity(r.ctx, lease.token); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	r.tokens = implementTokens{apps: apps, owners: []string{r.env.repo.Owner(), r.env.repoSecondOwner.Owner()}}
	r.identity, r.defaultBranch, r.secondDefaultBranch = identity, branches[0], branches[1]
	return nil
}
